metadata.confidence_method: Smallest radius about the smoothed MAP estimate containing at least 95% posterior mass, plus half a cell diagonal
metadata.bearing_method: Local true-north rotation of UTM grid bearings
metadata.replay_notice: Fixed synthetic observations drive these estimates. Browser locks do not recompute Bayes inference.
metadata.skyline_notice: 30 m terrain sampled every 15 m; horizons stop at this tile or nodata. Outside peaks and tree cover are absent.
metadata.route_notice: Model route only. Uses 30 m mean slope, maximum 5 m slope and a heuristic lake mask; no surveyed trails, rivers, vegetation or hazard review.
limitations: Not validated for real navigation or rescue
Declination is an unverified placeholder of zero degrees
Peak labels except Mt Moran are elevation labels, not verified geographic names
Posterior stage estimates can jump between distant modes before enough observations
Recorded elevation angle is not used by the reference localization model
Route excludes diagonal corner crossing and does not force blocked endpoints open

injured.reason: Start or rendezvous exceeds this slope limit
